metadata.case_name: FONG MO FUNG v. WONG YICK YING

plaintiff.occupation_before: casual worker carrying out indoor decoration work
plaintiff.education_level: Completed a course for security guards and granted a certificate

injuries.description: 8 cm laceration over left face involving left lower eyelid
source: (a) 8 cm laceration over left face involving left lower eyelid;
injuries.icd_description: Open wound of eyelid or periocular area
Laceration without foreign body of head

injuries.description: deep laceration over left wrist with tendon injury; superficial branch of ulnar nerve cut; ulnar artery cut; flexor carpi ulnaris tendon cut
source:
(d) deep laceration over left wrist with tendon injury and numbness over
left little finger;

left wrist laceration resulting in superficial branch of ulnar nerve
cut, ulnar artery cut, and flexor carpi ulnaris tendon cut.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of multiple sites of wrist
Laceration without foreign body of shoulder or upper arm

manifestations.description: lagophthalmos (eyes could not close completely) resulting in on-and-off pain and itchiness and intermittent tearing in the left eye
mild lid notching and cicatricial ectropion
left hand numbness, pain and weakness
increased sensation over the ulnar side of the left hand and fingers, consistent with the incomplete recovery of the superficial branch of the ulnar nerve
multiple scars consistent with the injuries
left ear and left arm pain and scarring
left wrist scarring, pain, weakness, numbness and stiffness

treatments_received.treatment: Repair of deltoid, superficial branch of ulnar nerve, ulnar artery and flexor carpi ulnaris tendon (orthopaedic operation)
source: Operation was carried out on 14 October 2006 to repair the deltoid, superficial branch of ulnar nerve, ulnar artery and flexor carpi ulnaris tendon.
treatments_received.vmis_procedure: Tendon repair / Suture of tendon of hand

treatments_received.treatment: Repair of left lower lid full thickness lacerations (ophthalmic operation)
source: While he was still in the hospital, the Plaintiff was also seen by a doctor of the Department of Ophthalmology, for left lower lid full thickness lacerations. Operation repair the eyelid was done on the day of the accident (i.e., 14 October 2006).

treatments_received.treatment: Wrist extension splint applied from 14 October 2006 until 6 November 2006
source: Wrist extension splint was applied to the Plaintiff from 14 October 2006 until 6 November 2006.
Then the Plaintiff undertook physiotherapy treatment from 8 November 2006 to 19 March 2007

treatments_received.treatment: Occupational therapy from 13 November 2006 to 9 November 2007
source: and further received occupational therapy treatment from 13 November 2006 to 9 November 2007.

losses.description: Left eye scarring, pain, frequent eye discharge and visual disturbance (lagophthalmos, reduced vision, intermittent tearing)
Left wrist scarring, pain, weakness, numbness and stiffness with reduced handgrip power

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Unable to swim and reduced hiking activity compared with pre-accident

comparable_cases.case_name: Chan Lai Po v. Au Wai Kit
comparable_cases.injury_description: Plaintiff suffered left traumatic 3rd nerve palsy with double vision, photophobia and restricted extra-ocular movements; expert considered 30% impairment of whole visual system (34% whole person)

comparable_cases.case_name: Yan Chui Sim v. Paul Y ITC General Contractors Limited & Others
comparable_cases.injury_description: Orthopaedic injury with psychiatric injury (depression / post traumatic stress disorder) leading to more serious overall injury
